description: Change a title's or caption's text, or restyle many at once (clip_ids, or every one on track_id). The style is merged; null turns an outline, shadow, box or highlight off (and max_lines back to all lines). spans (one clip) restyle part of its text. Fonts: video://catalog/fonts, or an unknown font is refused with the close matches. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

mode.description: Needs caption word timings. karaoke: each word takes color as it is spoken and keeps it; fill: likewise, sweeping across each word; word: only the word being spoken; pop: that word, growing a little

max_lines.description: At most this many lines at once: longer text shows in turn, a screenful at a time, each from its first word (by word timing, or by length without it). Lines are broken here, by the font, balanced in length; null shows it all at once

max_width.description: Of frame width: longer text wraps onto more lines, balanced in length

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

anyOf.description: Style part of the text: each span restyles words first_word to last_word (from 0: the timed words, or the text split at spaces), e.g. one word in yellow

spans.description: Only with a single clip: replaces its spans (null removes them). New text drops spans it doesn't give

style.description: Merged into each clip's style; null fields reset

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

track_id.description: Instead of clip_ids: every title and caption on a track

name: text.set

parent.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

frames.description: Frames shown; for a waveform, the start and end of its span

loudness.description: Measured for audio edits, over the waveform span

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

title: Set text
